with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def f(inp):
    n=len(inp); m=len(inp[0]); c=inp[0].index(2)
    g=[[0]*m for _ in range(n)]
    for d in range(-(m-1), m):
        if d%4!=2: continue
        # cells of diagonal d within grid
        cells=[(i,i+d) for i in range(max(0,-d), min(n,m-d))]
        if not any(i>=3 for i,_ in cells): continue
        for i,j in cells: g[i][j]=1
    for i in range(n):
        for j in (c-i,c+i):
            if 0<=j<m: g[i][j]=2
    return g

def f(I):
    N=len(I[0]); c=I[0].index(2)
    O=[[0]*N for _ in range(N)]
    for i in range(c+1):
        for dj in (c,-c):
            j=i+dj
            if 0<=j<N: O[i][j]=2
    # rays: diagonals d=j-i with d≡c (mod4), d≠c
    for d in range(-(N-1), N):
        if d==c: continue
        if (d-c)%4!=0: continue
        # cone cells on this diagonal: rows where j=i+d in [0,N) and is a cone cell
        cone_rows=[i for i in range(N) if 0<=i+d<N and O[i][i+d]==2]
        if not cone_rows: continue
        start=max(cone_rows)+1
        for i in range(start, N):
            j=i+d
            if 0<=j<N: O[i][j]=1
    return O
